rca_of_the_issue: SIEM export 500 RCA: /app/backend/routes/mailscanner.py:406 built CEF line via e.get('subject','')[:60]. Python dict .get(key, default) does NOT substitute default when the stored value is None — it only substitutes when the key is absent. Since MailEvent docs can have subject=None (nullable field), this crashed with 'NoneType is not subscriptable'. Fix: `(e.get('subject') or '')[:60]`. LEEF branch already used this defensive pattern; only CEF was buggy. Applied and re-verified 200 OK for all three formats.
